prompts.text: What is the strangest thing you have ever eaten and actually enjoyed?
Make up a conspiracy theory on the spot about why pigeons are always watching us.
What is a weird habit you have that you only do when no one is watching?
Speak only in questions for the next full minute.
If you had to be haunted by one ghost for the rest of your life, what ghost would you pick?
Invent a new hand gesture for a random emotion and demonstrate it with full seriousness.
What is the weirdest thing you have Googled at three in the morning?
Describe a sandwich in the style of a dramatic film trailer.
What animal do you feel a strange spiritual connection to, and why?
Try to sell a sock to the group as if it were a luxury product.
What is a completely normal thing that for some reason terrifies you?
Show the group the strangest screenshot on your phone and explain the story behind it.
If your life had a smell, what would it be and would people want to smell it?
Give the group a two-minute lecture on a topic you know absolutely nothing about.
What is the weirdest recurring dream you have had more than once?
Do your best impression of a feral animal guarding its food for the next thirty seconds.
